work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CXCVII lets the archpriest and canons of the collegiate church of Bracciano wear the cotta over the rochet; LF42705 → LF42709 across the garbled page number 2Q1 LF42708; LF42773 → LF42782 across own provenance LF42776 and the page-292 head LF42779; complete 15 January 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF42700–42700; the source closing at LF42802–42805 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quinta ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pon- tificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
